collection.description: A potter tests clay, ash and crushed stone for vessels that survive fire and sea spray.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A potter experiments with river clay, volcanic ash, and crushed stone, hoping to produce vessels that survive both fire and sea spray.

choices.label: Involve the village council and apprentices.

o1.name: Outcome 1
o1.text: A new firing technique yields sturdy glazed jars.

o2.name: Outcome 2
o2.text: The vessels crack into a spectacular heap; the potter records what went wrong.

o3.name: Outcome 3
o3.text: One jar emerges with a mysterious pattern no one remembers carving.
